member.remarks: Each method declared directly on the interface becomes an end point (members of inherited interfaces other than / are not implemented). The end point path is + (default the method name); without a , methods without parameters use GET and others POST. GET/DELETE format the path as a template using the parameter(s); POST/PUT send the parameter(s) as the payload (a null object if the method has no parameters, ex: "null" with the json serializer).
